senses.title: Shut something
senses.definition: to move a door, lid or window so that it is no longer open

senses.example: She closed the gate and locked it.
senses.exampleCN: 她关上院门并上了锁。

senses.whyCN: 拉丁词基本义就是关闭，因此这是最古老也最具体的义项。

senses.definition: to finish an activity, a meeting or a business deal

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the two sounds of the word, the shutting door and the friend who stands near.

sensesIntro.en: From shutting a door to finishing an event, and then to the nearness of people and things.

branches.en: Things inside an enclosure sit near each other, and people can be near in feeling.

intro.en: The Latin base produces a large family, with prefixes that add direction and endings that add grammar.

definition_zh: n. 接近；亲密；紧密；（比分等的）接近，势均力敌；闷塞
definition_en: the state of being near, intimate or tightly packed; a narrow margin
core_image: 两个人肩并肩坐着，中间几乎没有缝隙
scene: 比分如此接近，让最后一分钟格外紧张。The closeness of the score made the final minute tense.
sceneCN: 第 4 个义项：closeness 指比分的接近；句意是比分如此接近，让最后一分钟格外紧张。

senses.title: Nearness in space or time
senses.definition: the state of being a short distance or time away
senses.definitionCN: 距离或时间上很近的状态
senses.example: The closeness of the shops saves us time.
senses.exampleCN: 商店离得近，为我们省下时间。
senses.why: Close plus the noun suffix -ness names the state.
senses.whyCN: close 加名词后缀 -ness 表示状态。

senses.title: Intimacy between people
senses.definition: a warm and trusting relationship between people
senses.definitionCN: 人与人之间温暖而信任的关系
senses.example: Their closeness grew over many years.
senses.exampleCN: 他们的亲密在多年里渐渐加深。
senses.why: Nearness of space became nearness of heart.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的近变成了心上的近。

senses.title: A narrow margin
senses.definition: the small difference between two results or amounts
senses.definitionCN: 两个结果或数量之间很小的差别
senses.example: The closeness of the vote surprised the polls.
senses.exampleCN: 投票结果如此接近，出乎民调意料。
senses.why: Two nearly equal numbers are called close.
senses.whyCN: 两个几乎相等的数被称为「接近」。

senses.title: A stuffy quality of air
senses.definition: the heavy, airless quality of a room or day
senses.definitionCN: 房间或天气沉闷、不通风的感觉
senses.example: The closeness of the room made her sleepy.
senses.exampleCN: 房间的闷塞让她昏昏欲睡。
senses.why: Close air is shut in, with no breeze.
senses.whyCN: close air 指封闭无风。

definition_zh: n. 血块；凝块；v. 凝结，结块
definition_en: a thick lump formed when blood or another liquid thickens; to form such lumps
core_image: 一滴血在伤口表面慢慢凝成暗红的块
scene: 医生发现他腿上有一处血块。The doctor found a clot in his leg.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：clot 指血块；句意是医生发现他腿上有一处血块。

senses.title: A thick lump in a liquid
senses.definition: a soft thick mass formed when a liquid thickens
senses.definitionCN: 液体变稠时形成的软而厚的块
senses.example: A blood clot blocked the vein.
senses.exampleCN: 一块血块堵住了血管。
senses.why: Old English clot names a lump or mass.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 clot 指块状物。

senses.title: To form lumps

senses.definitionCN: 由液体变成软厚的块状物
senses.example: The sauce clotted when it cooled.
senses.exampleCN: 酱汁冷却后结成了块。
senses.why: The noun of a lump became a verb of lumping.
senses.whyCN: 表示块的名称变成了结成块的动词。

intro.en: Clot is an old word for a lump that settled into medicine and cooking.
intro.cn: clot 是表示「块」的古老词，后来进入医学与烹饪。

items.en: Clott means a lump or mass.
items.cn: clott 意为块、团。

items.en: Clotted cream names thick cream.
items.cn: 十四世纪 clotted cream 指浓稠奶油。

items.en: Clot is used for thickened blood.
items.cn: 十七世纪 clot 用于指凝固的血。

items.en: Doctors warn about clots in the veins.
items.cn: 十九世纪医生警告静脉血栓。

items.cn: 现代该词涵盖血液、奶油与酱汁。

The events of a story.
A narrow opening.

normalIntro.cn: clot 是本该是液体的地方出现的一团。

normal.en: Clot and clod are cousins.
normal.cn: clot 与 clod 是近亲。

normal.en: Blood clots to stop bleeding.
normal.cn: 血液凝结以止血。

normal.en: Clotted cream is thick.
normal.cn: clotted cream 很稠。

normal.en: A clot can block a vein.
normal.cn: 血块可能堵塞血管。

normal.en: Sauce left to cool may clot.

A dark knot inside a river.
Thickness with a purpose and a danger.

examples.en: Clotted cream is a treat in the west country.

definition_zh: 给…穿衣；为…提供衣物；用言语表达
definition_en: to put clothes on someone, to provide clothes for people, or to express an idea in words
core_image: 母亲把厚外套披到孩子肩上
scene: 冬天出发前，母亲把厚外套一件件披到孩子身上。Volunteers clothe the children before the cold season.
sceneCN: 这里 clothe 指「为…提供衣物」（第 2 个义项：给人们提供衣服）；句意是志愿者在寒季到来前为孩子们提供衣物。

pos.zh: 给…穿衣；为…提供衣物；表达

senses.title: Put clothes on someone
senses.definition: to dress someone in clothes
senses.definitionCN: 给某人穿上衣服
senses.example: She clothed the baby in a wool jacket.
senses.exampleCN: 她给宝宝穿上一件毛外套。
senses.why: The verb was built directly from the old noun for cloth, so it names the act of covering a body.
senses.whyCN: 这个动词直接由表示布的古名词构成，因此指给身体覆上衣物。

senses.title: Provide clothes for people
senses.definition: to supply clothes to a group of people who need them
senses.definitionCN: 向需要衣服的一群人提供衣物
senses.example: The charity clothes three hundred families.
senses.exampleCN: 这家慈善机构为三百个家庭提供衣物。
senses.why: Helping others dress extends the single act into regular support.
senses.whyCN: 帮助他人穿衣把这个单一动作扩展为长期帮扶。

senses.title: Express in words
senses.definition: to cover an idea with words, as if dressing it
senses.definitionCN: 像给想法穿上衣服一样用词语把它包起来
senses.example: He clothed his anger in polite words.
senses.exampleCN: 他用客气话把怒气包了起来。
senses.why: An idea without words looks naked, so dressing it became a metaphor for expressing it.
senses.whyCN: 没有词语的想法像是赤裸的，给它穿衣便成了表达的比喻。

branches.cn: 给一个人穿衣与给一群人穿衣共用一个动词。

branches.en: Both senses are about covering what needs protection.
branches.cn: 两个义项都是给需要保护的东西加覆盖。

intro.en: The stem folds into compounds and participles, all tied to clothing.
intro.cn: 这个词干融入复合词与分词，都与衣物相关。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English noun claþ.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语名词 claþ。

items.example: She clothes the children before school.
items.exampleCN: 她送孩子上学前给他们穿衣。

items.example: The hills were clothed in mist.
Warm clothing is the first need.
The workers were clad in blue.
The statue shows an unclothed figure.
items.exampleCN: 这尊雕像呈现一个裸身人像。

items.example: She hung the sheets on the clothesline.
items.exampleCN: 她把床单挂到晾衣绳上。

items.example: The clotheshorse stood by the window.
He works in a small clothes shop.
items.exampleCN: 他在一家小服装店工作。

definition_zh: 线索；提示；头绪
definition_en: a fact or object that helps to solve a problem or a mystery, or an understanding of a situation
core_image: 桌上摊开的纸片被一根线串起来
scene: 侦探把桌上的纸片一张张排开，寻找能串起来的线索。A single footprint gave the police their first clue.
sceneCN: 这里 clue 指「线索」（第 1 个义项：有助于解开谜团的事实或物件）；句意是一个脚印给了警方第一条线索。

senses.title: A fact that helps solve a mystery
senses.definition: a piece of evidence that points towards the answer
senses.definitionCN: 指向答案的一件证据
senses.example: The note was the only clue to his whereabouts.
senses.exampleCN: 那张字条是唯一能说明他去向的线索。
senses.why: A clue was a ball of thread that guided a hero out of a maze, so it still means something that guides.
senses.whyCN: clue 原是一团把英雄引出迷宫的线，因此至今指能引路的东西。

senses.title: Knowledge of a situation
senses.definition: an idea or understanding of what is happening
senses.definitionCN: 对正在发生之事的一点概念或了解
senses.example: She had no clue how the machine worked.
senses.exampleCN: 她对这台机器怎么运作毫无头绪。
senses.why: If a thread shows the way, then having a clue means knowing which way to go.
senses.whyCN: 如果线能指路，那么有线索就意味着知道往哪走。

intro.en: Clue comes from an old word for a ball of thread, the kind a hero used to find his way out.
intro.cn: clue 出自表示线团的古词，正是英雄用来找路走出迷宫的那种线。

items.en: Cliwen meant a ball of thread or yarn.
items.cn: cliwen 指一团线或纱。

items.en: A clew of thread guided a person through a maze in an old story.
items.cn: 在古老故事里，一团线引导人走出迷宫。

items.en: The spelling clue appeared beside the older clew.
items.cn: 拼写 clue 与较早的 clew 并行出现。

items.en: The meaning widened from thread to any guiding fact.
items.cn: 含义从线扩展到任何起引导作用的事实。

items.en: A clue is now a fact that helps solve a problem.
items.cn: clue 如今指有助于解决问题的线索。

note.en: The look-alike group holds short words with the same sound or shape, while the meaning group names signs and evidence.
note.cn: 形近组收同音或形近的短词，近义组列出迹象与证据。

entries.definition: a thick liquid used to stick things together
entries.definitionCN: 用来粘合东西的黏稠液体

entries.definition: having the colour of a clear sky
a signal that tells someone to begin
a small piece of advice that helps you guess
entries.definitionCN: 帮助猜测的一点点提示

entries.definition: something that shows that a fact exists
entries.definitionCN: 显示某种事实存在的事物

entries.definition: facts that support a belief or a case
entries.definitionCN: 支持某种看法或案件的事实

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the ball of thread, the maze and the moment of having no idea.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从线团、迷宫和毫无头绪的那一刻入手。

normal.en: Clue and clew are the same word; clew is the old spelling for a ball of thread.
normal.cn: clue 与 clew 本是同一个词，clew 是线团的旧拼法。

normal.en: Clue and glue differ by one letter: glue sticks, a clue leads.
normal.cn: clue 与 glue 只差一个字母：胶水粘住，线索引路。

normal.en: A detective follows a clue the way a hero follows a thread.
normal.cn: 侦探顺线索查案，就像英雄顺线而行。

normal.en: No clue means the thread has slipped out of your hand.
normal.cn: no clue 就是线从手里滑走了。

normal.en: Clueless adds -less, so the person has no guiding thread at all.
normal.cn: clueless 加了 -less，指人一点引路的线都没有。

abstract.en: Picture a red thread running along a stone floor in the dark.
abstract.cn: 想象黑暗中一条红线沿着石地延伸。

abstract.en: Picture a footprint in soft mud beside a broken gate.
abstract.cn: 想象破门旁软泥里的一枚脚印。

abstract.en: Picture a person shrugging in front of a confusing map.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人面对看不懂的地图耸了耸肩。

examples.en: The muddy shoe left a clue beside the door.
examples.cn: 那只沾泥的鞋在门边留下了线索。

examples.en: Nobody had a clue what the letter meant.
examples.cn: 没人知道那封信是什么意思。

examples.en: Her calm reply gave him a clue about her mood.
examples.cn: 她平静的回答让他对她的情绪有了点头绪。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 clue 记成「一团线」：握住线头，顺着走，就能走出迷雾。

root: 源自古英语 cliwen（线团），旧拼 clew，因线团引路的故事引申为线索。

sensesIntro.en: From a thread that leads the way to any fact that leads the mind.
sensesIntro.cn: 从引路的线，到任何能引出思路的事实。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thread held in the hand, running into the dark.
core.cn: 核心意象：手里握着一根线，伸进黑暗里。

branches.en: The evidence sense keeps the picture of a guiding thread.
branches.cn: 证据义保留了引路线索的画面。

branches.en: Having a clue means holding the thread of a situation.
branches.cn: 有头绪就意味着握着局势的线头。

branches.en: Both senses describe something that reduces confusion.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述能减少困惑的东西。

branches.en: A clue points outward, to a fact in the world.
branches.cn: 线索向外指，指向世间的一件事实。

branches.en: The same thread can lead to a suspect or to understanding.
branches.cn: 同一根线既能引向嫌疑人，也能引向理解。

intro.en: The stem keeps the old thread word alive and adds modern compounds.
intro.cn: 这个词干保住了古老的线团词，并构成现代复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Old English noun cliwen.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是古英语名词 cliwen。

items.meaning: more than one piece of evidence
items.exampleCN: 这个房间提供了好几条线索。

items.example: He was clueless about the new rules.

items.exampleCN: 她的一无所知让团队吃惊。

items.example: He is clued-up on local politics.

items.meaning: a ball of thread, the older form of clue
items.example: Clew still appears in sailing texts.
items.exampleCN: clew 仍出现在航海文本中。

items.meaning: the activity of searching for clues
built on hints rather than direct proof
items.example: The game is a clue-based puzzle.
items.exampleCN: 这个游戏是基于线索的解谜。

items.example: She made a few clue-giving remarks.
items.exampleCN: 她说了几句提示性的话。

definition_zh: 笨手笨脚的；粗糙笨重的；不得体的
definition_en: moving or handling things in an awkward way, badly made, or not tactful
core_image: 端着一摞盘子撞上门框时手肘一歪
scene: 他端着一摞盘子，走过窄门时手肘撞到了门框。He made a clumsy attempt to catch the falling cup.
sceneCN: 这里 clumsy 指「笨手笨脚的」（第 1 个义项：动作不灵巧）；句意是他笨拙地伸手去接掉落的杯子。

pos.zh: 笨手笨脚的；粗糙的；不得体的

senses.title: Awkward in movement
senses.definition: moving the body or handling objects in a way that is not smooth
senses.definitionCN: 身体动作或拿取物件时不灵巧流畅
senses.example: Her clumsy fingers dropped the key twice.
senses.exampleCN: 她笨拙的手指把钥匙掉了两次。
senses.why: The word first described limbs stiff with cold, so awkward movement is its oldest picture.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初形容冻僵的四肢，因此不灵巧的动作是它最古老的画面。

senses.title: Badly made or designed
senses.definition: made or built in a rough way that shows little skill
senses.definitionCN: 制作或建造粗糙，显出缺少手艺
senses.example: The table was a clumsy copy of a French design.
senses.exampleCN: 这张桌子是对法式设计的粗糙模仿。
senses.why: A hand that cannot work smoothly leaves marks on the things it makes.
senses.whyCN: 不灵巧的手会在它做出的东西上留下痕迹。

senses.title: Not tactful
senses.definition: said or done without skill or care for other people's feelings
senses.definitionCN: 说话做事缺少技巧，未顾及他人感受
senses.example: He made a clumsy apology and left the room.
senses.exampleCN: 他笨拙地道了个歉，然后离开了房间。
senses.why: Words can be handled as badly as objects, so social mistakes borrowed the same adjective.
senses.whyCN: 话语和物件一样会被拿得很糟，于是社交失误也用了同一个形容词。

intro.en: Clumsy began with cold-stiffened limbs, not with a lack of skill.
intro.cn: clumsy 最初说的是被冻僵的四肢，而不是缺少技巧。

items.en: Clumsen meant to be numb or stiff with cold.
items.cn: clumsen 指被冻得麻木或僵硬。

items.en: Clumsy described limbs that were stiff with cold.
items.cn: clumsy 形容被冻僵的四肢。

items.en: The sense widened to any awkward movement.
items.cn: 含义扩展到任何不灵巧的动作。

items.en: Clumsy work meant rough work done without skill.
items.cn: clumsy work 指缺少手艺的粗活。

items.en: The word now also covers tactless remarks and awkward timing.
items.cn: 这个词如今还指不得体的话语与尴尬的时机。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in sound or spelling, while the meaning group names awkwardness.
note.cn: 形近组收读音或拼写接近的词，近义组列出笨拙的说法。

entries.definition: unpleasantly damp and sticky
in an awkward and unskilful way
entries.definitionCN: 以笨拙而不熟练的方式

entries.definition: the quality of moving without skill
moving in a way that looks uncomfortable
moving in a heavy and clumsy way
having no skill for a task
entries.definitionCN: 对某项事务毫无技巧的

normalIntro.en: These hooks use cold fingers, the dropped cup and the apology that lands badly.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从冻僵的手指、掉落的杯子和说砸了的道歉入手。

normal.en: Clumsy fingers in winter cannot button a coat, and that is where the word began.
normal.cn: 冬天冻僵的手指扣不上外套，这正是这个词的起点。

normal.en: Clumsy ends in y like many adjectives, and the adverb swaps y for ily.
normal.cn: clumsy 像许多形容词一样以 y 结尾，副词把 y 换成 ily。

normal.en: A clumsy table looks as if a hand shook while cutting it.
normal.cn: clumsy table 看起来像下锯时手在抖。

normal.en: A clumsy apology is a sentence that trips over itself.
normal.cn: clumsy apology 就是一句自己绊倒自己的话。

normal.en: Clumsiness adds -ness and turns the quality into a noun.
normal.cn: clumsiness 加 -ness，把这种特质变成名词。

abstract.en: Picture a stack of plates tipping while a man reaches for the door.
abstract.cn: 想象一摞盘子倾斜，而那人正伸手去够门。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden chair with one leg a little too short.
abstract.cn: 想象一把木椅，其中一条腿短了一点。

abstract.en: Picture a speaker stopping in the middle of a wrong word.
abstract.cn: 想象一位说话者卡在一个用错的词中间。

examples.en: His clumsy hands knocked over the glass.
examples.cn: 他笨拙的手把玻璃杯碰倒了。

examples.en: The first version of the tool was heavy and clumsy.
examples.cn: 这个工具最初的版本又重又笨。

examples.en: She made a clumsy joke about his new haircut.
examples.cn: 她拿他的新发型开了个不得体的玩笑。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 clumsy 记成「冻僵的手」：手指不听使唤，做什么都碰倒东西。

root: 源自中古英语 clumsen（冻得麻木僵硬），后由僵硬的肢体引申为动作笨拙。

sensesIntro.en: From stiff cold limbs to rough work and then to words that handle feelings badly.
sensesIntro.cn: 从冻僵的四肢，到粗糙的手工，再到不会照顾感受的话语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: hands that cannot move smoothly and knock things over.
core.cn: 核心意象：动作不顺畅的手把东西碰倒。

branches.en: The body sense keeps the oldest picture of stiff, cold hands.
branches.cn: 身体义保留了冻僵双手的最古老画面。

branches.en: An unskilful hand leaves its awkwardness in the object.
branches.cn: 不灵巧的手把笨拙留在了物件上。

branches.en: Words can be dropped as easily as cups.
branches.cn: 话语和杯子一样容易掉在地上。

branches.en: Both senses rest on a lack of smooth control.
branches.cn: 两个义项都建立在缺少顺畅控制之上。

branches.en: Rough making and rough speaking both show a missing skill.
branches.cn: 做活粗糙与说话粗糙都显出技巧的缺失。

intro.en: The stem grows comparison forms, an adverb and a noun, plus a few compounds.
intro.cn: 这个词干长出比较级、副词与名词，并构成若干复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is the Middle English verb clumsen, to be numb with cold.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是中古英语动词 clumsen（冻得麻木）。

items.example: His left hand is the clumsier of the two.
items.exampleCN: 他左手比右手更不灵巧。

items.example: That was the clumsiest attempt of the day.
items.exampleCN: 那是当天最笨拙的一次尝试。
他笨手笨脚地折起地图。
clumse 衍生出形容词 clumsy。

items.example: The boy was clumsy-handed with small tools.
items.exampleCN: 这男孩用起小工具来手很笨。

items.example: He was clumsy-footed on the stairs.
The machine is clumsy-looking but strong.
items.exampleCN: 这台机器样子笨拙却很结实。

definition_zh: n. 一簇，一串，一群；（产业）集群；v. 聚集，群集
definition_en: a group of similar things or people close together; to form such a group
core_image: 藤架下垂着一串串饱满的葡萄
scene: 葡萄一串串垂在藤架下。Clusters of grapes hung under the trellis.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：cluster 指一串；句意是葡萄一串串垂在藤架下。

senses.title: A group of similar things
senses.definition: several similar things growing or placed close together
senses.definitionCN: 若干相似之物长在一起或摆在一起
senses.example: A cluster of stars shone in the sky.
senses.exampleCN: 一簇星星在天上闪烁。
senses.why: Old English clyster names a bunch of grapes.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 clyster 指一串葡萄。

senses.title: A group of firms or people
senses.definition: a group of businesses or people gathered in one place
senses.definitionCN: 聚集在一处的企业或人群
senses.example: A cluster of tech firms grew near the station.
senses.exampleCN: 车站附近成长起一群科技公司。
senses.why: The bunch image widened to economic groups.
senses.whyCN: 一串的形象扩展到经济群体。

senses.title: To gather in a group
senses.definition: to stand or grow close together in a group
senses.definitionCN: 成群地站在一起或长在一起
senses.example: The children clustered around the storyteller.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们围聚在讲故事的人身边。
senses.why: The noun of a bunch became a verb of bunching.
senses.whyCN: 表示串的名词变成聚拢的动词。

intro.en: Cluster begins as a bunch of grapes and ends as a word for groups of every kind.
intro.cn: cluster 从一串葡萄开始，最后指各种群体。

items.en: Clyster names a bunch, especially of grapes.
items.cn: clyster 指串，尤指葡萄串。

items.en: Writers use cluster for fruit on the vine.
items.cn: 十四世纪作家用它指藤上的果实。

items.en: A cluster of stars names a star group.
items.cn: 十七世纪 cluster 指星团。

items.en: Economists speak of industry clusters.
items.cn: 二十世纪经济学家谈产业集群。

items.en: Computer clusters link many machines.
items.cn: 现代计算机集群连接多台机器。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cl- start; the near-meaning group names bunches and crowds.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cl- 开头；近义组列出串束与人群。

entries.definition: A lot of untidy things.
A series of hard sounds.
A hook that holds two parts.
A group of things held together.
A large moving group of insects or people.
A group of people met together.

normalIntro.en: A cluster is a handful of similar things holding together.
normalIntro.cn: cluster 就是一把相似的、聚在一起的东西。

normal.en: Cluster and clyster share a root.
normal.cn: cluster 与 clyster 同源。

normal.en: Grapes grow in clusters.
normal.cn: 葡萄成串生长。

normal.en: Stars form clusters.
normal.cn: 星星组成星团。

normal.en: Firms form a cluster.
normal.cn: 公司组成集群。

normal.en: People cluster round a speaker.
normal.cn: 人们围聚在演讲者身边。

abstract.en: Many small things agreeing to be one.
abstract.cn: 许多小东西同意成为一个。

abstract.en: A bunch of light in the dark.
Distance cancelled by company.

examples.en: A cluster of white flowers grew by the wall.
examples.cn: 墙边开着一簇白花。

examples.en: The village is a cluster of houses round a well.
examples.cn: 这个村子是一群围着水井的房子。

examples.en: Reporters clustered around the singer.
examples.cn: 记者们围聚在歌手身边。

dict_mnemonic.text: 葡萄成串、星星成团、公司成群，都是 cluster。

root: 古英语 clyster（一串，尤指葡萄）→ 现代 cluster（簇、群、聚集）

sensesIntro.en: A bunch of grapes became a bunch of stars, firms and people.
sensesIntro.cn: 一串葡萄变成了一群星、企业与人群。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: grapes hanging in a tight bunch
core.cn: 核心意象：紧紧垂挂的一串葡萄

branches.en: Grapes under a trellis.
Stars packed in one patch.
Tech firms on one street.
Children round a storyteller.
A bunch that becomes a community.

intro.en: Cluster is a word of bunches; the list adds gathering and grouping pieces.
intro.cn: cluster 是串束之词；下面列出聚集与分组词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin grex is a flock, cumulus is a heap, and congregare is to gather.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 grex 意为群，cumulus 意为堆，congregare 意为聚集。

latinEntries.exampleCN: grex 产生 gregarious 与 congregate。
cumulus 产生 cumulus 与 accumulate。
congregare 产生 congregate 与 congregation。

definition_zh: v. 紧抓，紧握；n. 离合器；一窝（蛋）；（体育）关键时刻
definition_en: to hold something tightly; a vehicle pedal or part; a set of eggs; a critical moment
core_image: 慌乱中双手死死抓住栏杆
scene: 她紧紧抓住栏杆，生怕滑倒。She clutched the rail to keep from slipping.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：clutch 指紧抓；句意是她紧紧抓住栏杆，生怕滑倒。

senses.title: To hold tightly
senses.definition: to hold something very firmly, often in fear
senses.definitionCN: 常因恐惧而牢牢抓住某物
senses.example: He clutched the letter in fear.
senses.exampleCN: 他惊恐地攥着那封信。
senses.why: Old English clyccan means to clutch or grip.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 clyccan 意为抓握、抓紧。

senses.title: A vehicle part
senses.definition: a pedal or part that connects and disconnects engine power
senses.definitionCN: 连接或断开发动机动力的踏板或部件
senses.example: Press the clutch before you change gear.
senses.exampleCN: 换挡前先踩离合器。
senses.why: The gripping part of a machine took the name.
senses.whyCN: 机器中「抓住」的部件沿用了这个词。

senses.title: A set of eggs
senses.definition: a group of eggs laid and sat on together
senses.definitionCN: 一起产下并被孵的一窝蛋
senses.example: The hen sat on a clutch of eggs.
senses.exampleCN: 母鸡孵着一窝蛋。
senses.why: A cluster or grip of eggs became a clutch.
senses.whyCN: 一握之量的蛋成了一窝。

senses.title: A critical moment
senses.definition: a very important moment when a result is decided
senses.definitionCN: 决定胜负的关键时刻
senses.example: He scored twice in the clutch.
senses.exampleCN: 他在关键时刻得了两分。
senses.why: The sense grew in American sports writing.
senses.whyCN: 此义见于美国体育写作。

intro.en: Clutch starts as a hand grip and spreads to machines, eggs and sport.
intro.cn: clutch 从手的抓握开始，扩展到机器、蛋与体育。

items.en: Clyccan means to clutch or hold.
items.cn: clyccan 意为抓紧、握住。

items.en: Clutch names a tight hold with the hand.
items.cn: 十四世纪 clutch 指用手紧紧握住。

items.en: A clutch of eggs names one sitting.
items.cn: 十九世纪 a clutch of eggs 指一窝蛋。

items.en: The clutch pedal enters motor cars.
items.cn: 二十世纪离合器踏板进入汽车。

items.en: In the clutch means at the decisive moment.
items.cn: 现代 in the clutch 指关键时刻。

note.en: The look-alike group shares a hard ending; the near-meaning group names other ways of seizing.
note.cn: 形近组共享硬辅音结尾；近义组列出抓取的说法。

entries.definition: To close the hand tightly.
A hook that holds two parts.
A stick used for walking.
To hold something firmly.
To take hold of something.
To take hold quickly and firmly.

normalIntro.en: To clutch is to hold as if letting go would be dangerous.
normalIntro.cn: clutch 就是像松手会有危险那样紧抓。

normal.en: Clutch sounds like a quick grab.
normal.cn: clutch 听起来像猛地一抓。

normal.en: A scared child clutches a hand.
normal.cn: 害怕的孩子紧抓大人的手。

normal.en: A car clutch grips engine power.
normal.cn: 汽车离合器抓住动力。

normal.en: A hen sits on a clutch of eggs.
normal.cn: 母鸡伏在一窝蛋上。

normal.en: Score in the clutch means score when it matters.
normal.cn: in the clutch 指关键时刻得分。

abstract.en: Fear with fingers.
Power held and released.
A small warm circle of eggs.

examples.en: She clutched her passport at the border.
examples.cn: 她在边境紧握着护照。

examples.en: The driver released the clutch too quickly.
examples.cn: 司机松离合器松得太快。

examples.en: The hawk guards its clutch on the cliff.
examples.cn: 鹰守护着崖上的一窝蛋。

dict_mnemonic.text: clutch 一抓：抓手、抓动力（离合器）、抓一窝蛋、抓关键时刻。

root: 古英语 clyccan（抓紧）→ 中古英语 clucchen → 现代 clutch

sensesIntro.en: A gripping hand, a gripping machine part, a sitting of eggs, a gripping moment.
sensesIntro.cn: 抓握的手、抓动力的机件、一窝蛋、扣人心弦的一刻。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: white knuckles on a metal rail
core.cn: 核心意象：紧抓金属栏杆的发白指节

branches.en: A hand round a passport.
A foot on a clutch pedal.
A hen over warm eggs.
A shot in the final second.
Holding tight, in body and in nerves.

intro.en: Clutch is a word of seizing; the list adds grasp and machine pieces.
intro.cn: clutch 是抓取之词；下面列出握持与机械词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin prehendere is to seize and capere is to take.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 prehendere 意为抓住，capere 意为拿取。

latinEntries.exampleCN: prehendere 产生 apprehend 与 comprehend。
capere 产生 capture 与 captive。
machina 产生 machine 与 mechanic。

definition_zh: n. 杂物，凌乱的东西；v. 使凌乱，堆满
definition_en: a lot of things lying about untidily; to fill a place with such things
core_image: 书桌上论文、杯子和旧报纸堆成小山
scene: 书桌上堆满杂物，她几乎找不到那支笔。The desk was full of clutter, and she could not find the pen.
sceneCN: 第 1 个义项：clutter 指杂物；句意是书桌上堆满杂物，她几乎找不到那支笔。

senses.title: A lot of untidy things
senses.definition: many objects lying about in an untidy way
senses.definitionCN: 许多乱放的东西
senses.example: The room was full of clutter.
senses.exampleCN: 房间里堆满杂物。
senses.why: Clutter began as a word for a clotted mass.
senses.whyCN: clutter 最初指凝结成团之物。

senses.title: To fill a place untidily
senses.definition: to cover or fill a place with too many things
senses.definitionCN: 用太多东西杂乱地占满一处
senses.example: Boxes cluttered the hallway.
senses.exampleCN: 箱子把门厅堆得乱七八糟。
senses.why: The noun of a mess became a verb of messing.
senses.whyCN: 表示杂乱的名称变成弄乱的动词。

intro.en: Clutter begins as a clot of things and becomes the word for domestic mess.
intro.cn: clutter 从「凝成团的东西」开始，后来指家里的杂乱。

items.en: Clotter means to clot or clot together.
items.cn: clotter 意为凝结、结块。

items.en: Clutter names a confused heap of things.
items.cn: 十八世纪 clutter 指乱堆的东西。

items.en: Writers describe cluttered Victorian rooms.
items.cn: 十九世纪作家描写堆满杂物的房间。

items.en: Designers speak of visual clutter.
items.cn: 二十世纪设计师谈视觉杂乱。

items.en: Software is praised for having no clutter.
items.cn: 现代也称赞界面「无杂乱」。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the cl- start; the near-meaning group names mess and jumble.
note.cn: 形近组共享 cl- 开头；近义组列出杂乱与乱堆。

entries.definition: A group of things close together.
A series of hard sounds.
A quick light movement.
An untidy state.
An untidy mixture of things.
A lack of order.

normalIntro.en: Clutter is a clot of objects that should have been put away.
normalIntro.cn: clutter 就是一团本该收起来的东西。

normal.en: Clutter sounds like a pile falling.
normal.cn: clutter 听起来像一堆东西倒下。

normal.en: Papers clutter a desk.
normal.cn: 纸堆满书桌。

normal.en: Boxes clutter a hall.
normal.cn: 箱子堆满门厅。

normal.en: Clear the clutter to think.
normal.cn: 清理杂物才能思考。

normal.en: Visual clutter tires the eye.
normal.cn: 视觉杂乱让眼睛疲劳。

abstract.en: Objects refusing to leave.
A room talking too much.
Order buried under things.

examples.en: Clear the clutter from the kitchen table.
examples.cn: 把厨房桌上的杂物清走。

examples.en: Old toys clutter the attic.
examples.cn: 旧玩具堆满阁楼。

examples.en: The site is too full of visual clutter.
examples.cn: 这个页面视觉上太杂乱。

dict_mnemonic.text: clot（结成团）+ -ter → 东西结成一团放不下，就是 clutter 杂物。

root: 十六世纪英语 clotter（凝结成块）→ 十八世纪 clutter（乱堆、杂物）

sensesIntro.en: Things that clot together become the mess on a desk.
sensesIntro.cn: 凝结成团的东西，成了桌上的杂乱。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a desk buried under cups and papers
core.cn: 核心意象：被杯子和纸埋住的桌子

branches.en: Cups and papers on a desk.
Boxes blocking a hallway.
Toys filling an attic.
Ads crowding a web page.
Things that fill space without purpose.
branches.cn: 毫无意义地占满空间的东西。

intro.en: Clutter is a word of messy masses; the list adds disorder and arranging pieces.
intro.cn: clutter 是杂乱成团之词；下面列出混乱与整理词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Latin turba is a crowd, miscere is to mix, and ordinare is to set in order.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 turba 意为人群，miscere 意为混合，ordinare 意为整理。

latinEntries.exampleCN: turba 产生 disturb 与 turbulent。
miscere 产生 mix 与 mixture。
ordinare 产生 order 与 ordinary。

definition_zh: 教练；长途汽车；（火车）车厢；辅导
definition_en: a person who trains a team or a performer, a bus for long journeys, or to train someone
core_image: 球场边蹲下来对球员说话的那个人
scene: 球场边，一位穿运动服的人蹲下来，对球员比划传球的方向。The coach stopped the drill to explain the pass again.
sceneCN: 这里 coach 指「教练」（第 1 个义项：训练队伍的人）；句意是教练停下训练，重新讲解传球。

senses.title: A person who trains others
senses.definition: a person who trains a sports team or an individual performer
senses.definitionCN: 训练运动队或个别运动员的人
senses.example: The coach praised the team after the match.
senses.exampleCN: 赛后教练表扬了队伍。
senses.why: A coach once carried people to a place, and a trainer now carries a learner to a goal.
senses.whyCN: coach 曾是把人送到某处的马车，而教练是把学习者带向目标的人。

senses.title: A long-distance bus or carriage
senses.definition: a bus used for journeys between towns, or a carriage of a train
senses.definitionCN: 往返城镇之间的客车，或火车的一节车厢
senses.example: We travelled by coach from London to the coast.
senses.exampleCN: 我们乘长途汽车从伦敦去海边。
senses.why: The word entered English as a carriage, and the vehicle sense has never been lost.
senses.whyCN: 这个词以马车之义进入英语，车辆义从未消失。

senses.title: Train or tutor someone
senses.definition: to teach someone the skills of a sport or a subject
senses.definitionCN: 教某人某项运动或某门学科的技能
senses.example: She coaches students in maths on weekends.
senses.exampleCN: 她周末给学生辅导数学。
senses.why: The verb grew from the person who carries learners forward, first at university and then on the field.
senses.whyCN: 动词由「带着学习者前进的人」而来，先在大学出现，后进入球场。

intro.en: Coach comes from a Hungarian village that built good wagons, not from anything about sport.
intro.cn: coach 出自一个会造好车的匈牙利村庄，与体育毫无关系。

items.en: Kocsi named a wagon built in the village of Kocs.
items.cn: kocsi 指在科奇村制造的马车。

items.en: The word became coche, a comfortable carriage.
items.cn: 这个词在法语中成为 coche，指舒适的马车。

items.en: Coach named a horse-drawn carriage for passengers.
items.cn: coach 指载客的马拉车。

items.en: Students used coach for a private tutor who carried them through exams.
items.cn: 学生用 coach 指带他们通过考试的私人辅导老师。

items.en: Coach now covers buses, train carriages and sports trainers.
items.cn: coach 如今涵盖长途汽车、火车车厢与体育教练。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words close in spelling, while the meaning group names trainers and passenger vehicles.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的词，近义组列出教练与载客车辆。

entries.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people
entries.definitionCN: 可供两三人坐的长软椅

entries.definition: a piece of clothing worn over other clothes
entries.definitionCN: 穿在其他衣服外面的衣物

entries.definition: as many people as a bus can carry
a person who teaches a sport or a skill
a teacher who works with one student or a small group
entries.definitionCN: 对一名或少数学生授课的教师

entries.definition: a large road vehicle that carries passengers
entries.definitionCN: 在公路上载客的大型车辆

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the Hungarian village, the carriage and the person who carries a learner forward.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从匈牙利村庄、马车和带着学习者前进的人入手。

normal.en: Coach and couch differ by one letter: a coach carries you, a couch holds you.
normal.cn: coach 与 couch 只差一个字母：前者载你走，后者托你坐。

normal.en: The first coach was a wagon from a village called Kocs.
normal.cn: 最早的 coach 是来自科奇村的马车。

normal.en: A coach takes you from town to town, and a coach takes you from novice to expert.
normal.cn: coach 送你从一镇到另一镇，也送你从新手到熟手。

normal.en: Head coach is the top one, assistant coach is the helper.
normal.cn: head coach 是主教练，assistant coach 是助理。

normal.en: The verb coach keeps the same spelling, so only the ending changes.
normal.cn: 动词 coach 拼写不变，只有词尾变化。

abstract.en: Picture a wooden carriage with four horses on a dusty road.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆四匹马拉的木马车走在土路上。

abstract.en: Picture a whistle, a cone and a coach kneeling on the grass.
abstract.cn: 想象哨子、标志锥，以及跪在草地上的教练。

abstract.en: Picture a student and a tutor at a small table with one lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象学生与辅导老师在一张小桌旁，只有一盏灯。

examples.en: The coach changed the formation at half time.
examples.cn: 教练在中场休息时改变了阵型。

examples.en: A coach leaves for the airport every hour.
examples.cn: 每小时有一班长途汽车开往机场。

examples.en: He coached the younger players for two seasons.
examples.cn: 他带了年轻队员两个赛季。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 coach 记成「把你送到目的地的人或车」：车载人上路，教练带人上路。

root: 源自匈牙利语 kocsi（科奇村造的车），经法语 coche 进入英语，由马车引申为客车与教练。

sensesIntro.en: From a village wagon to a passenger bus, and then to the person who carries a learner forward.
sensesIntro.cn: 从村庄的马车，到载客的汽车，再到带着学习者前进的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a vehicle that carries people towards a place.
core.cn: 核心意象：一辆把人送往某地的车。

branches.en: The trainer sense keeps the idea of carrying a learner to a goal.
branches.cn: 教练义保留了把学习者带向目标的意味。

branches.en: The vehicle sense is the oldest and still the most literal.
branches.cn: 车辆义最古老，也最字面。

branches.en: The verb turns the carrier into an action of teaching.
branches.cn: 动词把「运送者」变成教学的动作。

branches.en: The person and the act of training share one word.
branches.cn: 教练这个人与训练这个动作共用一个词。

branches.en: Both senses describe help with getting somewhere.
branches.cn: 两个义项都描述帮助人抵达某处。

intro.en: The stem takes the usual verb endings and compounds for vehicles and people.
intro.cn: 这个词干接受常见动词词尾，并构成车辆与人物类复合词。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin base; the root is Hungarian kocsi, a wagon from the village of Kocs.
latinIntro.cn: 这里没有拉丁词基，词根是匈牙利语 kocsi（科奇村的马车）。

items.meaning: trains a person or a team

items.example: He coached her through the exam.
Coaching takes patience more than knowledge.
items.exampleCN: 辅导需要耐心多于知识。

items.meaning: as many people as a bus holds
items.example: A coachload of tourists arrived at noon.

items.meaning: a person who drove a horse-drawn coach
items.example: The coachman waited in the rain.

items.meaning: a place where long-distance buses stop
items.example: The coach station is behind the market.
items.exampleCN: 长途汽车站在市场后面。

items.meaning: a journey made by long-distance bus
items.example: The school arranged a coach trip.
items.exampleCN: 学校安排了一次大巴旅行。

items.meaning: the leading trainer of a team
items.example: The head coach signed a new contract.

definition_zh: 粗糙的；粗俗的；粗粒的
definition_en: rough to touch, made of large particles, or rude and offensive
core_image: 麻袋布面上扎手的一根根粗纤维
scene: 麻袋的布面扎手，纤维一根根粗得看得清。The sack was made of coarse cloth that scratched his hands.
sceneCN: 这里 coarse 指「粗糙的」（第 1 个义项：手感不光滑）；句意是这只麻袋用粗糙的布做成，扎他的手。

senses.title: Rough to the touch
senses.definition: made of thick threads or fibres and not smooth to touch
senses.definitionCN: 由粗线或粗纤维制成、摸起来不光滑
senses.example: The sack was made of coarse cloth.
senses.exampleCN: 这只麻袋是用粗布做的。
senses.why: The word began as a spelling of course, meaning plain and ordinary, and plain cloth is often rough.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本是 course 的另一种拼法，意为平常普通，而普通的布往往粗糙。

senses.title: Rude and offensive
senses.definition: using words or behaving in a way that offends people
senses.definitionCN: 用词或举止令人反感
senses.example: His coarse jokes embarrassed the guests.
senses.exampleCN: 他粗俗的玩笑让客人尴尬。
senses.why: Rough cloth and rough speech share the idea of something unrefined.
senses.whyCN: 粗糙的布与粗鲁的言语共享「未经打磨」这一意思。

senses.title: Made of large particles
senses.definition: consisting of relatively large pieces or grains
senses.definitionCN: 由相对较大的块或颗粒组成
senses.example: Coarse sand drains faster than fine sand.
senses.exampleCN: 粗砂比细砂排水快。
senses.why: A grain that is not ground fine looks rough under the fingers, so the texture word covers size too.
senses.whyCN: 没有磨细的颗粒摸起来粗糙，于是质地词也涵盖了颗粒大小。

intro.en: Coarse is a later spelling of course, and the two words split only in the eighteenth century.
intro.cn: coarse 是 course 的后起拼法，两词到十八世纪才分开。

items.en: Cursus meant a running or a set path.
items.cn: cursus 指奔跑或固定的路径。

items.en: Cours meant ordinary, plain or of the usual kind.
items.cn: cours 意为普通的、平常的。

items.en: Course could describe plain everyday cloth.
items.cn: course 可以形容日常的普通布料。

items.en: Coarse was fixed as a separate spelling for rough things.
items.cn: coarse 被固定为表示粗糙之物的独立拼法。

items.en: The word now also means rude and large-grained.
items.cn: 这个词如今还指粗鲁与颗粒粗大。

note.en: The look-alike group holds words that sound the same but differ in spelling, while the meaning group names roughness.
note.cn: 形近组收同音但拼写不同的词，近义组列出粗糙与粗野。

entries.definition: a series of lessons or the direction of travel
entries.definitionCN: 一系列课程，或行进的方向

entries.definition: having a rough voice because of a sore throat
entries.definitionCN: 因喉咙痛而声音沙哑的

entries.definition: in a rough or rude manner
not smooth or even on the surface
simple and without skill or fine detail
entries.definitionCN: 简单而缺少技巧或细节的

entries.definition: offensive in a way that shows bad manners
entries.definitionCN: 以失礼方式令人反感的

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the identical sound with course, the rough sack and the large grains.
normalIntro.cn: 这些记忆钩子从与 course 同音、扎手的麻袋和粗大颗粒入手。

normal.en: Coarse and course sound the same; the shorter spelling belongs to rough things.
normal.cn: coarse 与 course 同音，拼写较短的那个指粗糙之物。

normal.en: Coarse cloth is cloth that has not been smoothed.
normal.cn: coarse cloth 就是没有弄光滑的布。

normal.en: Coarse sand leaves the fingers feeling the grains.
normal.cn: 粗砂让手指摸得到一颗颗砂粒。

normal.en: Coarse jokes are jokes that rub the wrong way.
normal.cn: coarse jokes 就是逆着人来的玩笑。

normal.en: Coarsen adds -en and makes the adjective into a verb.
normal.cn: coarsen 加 -en，把形容词变成动词。

abstract.en: Picture a burlap sack with thick brown threads.
abstract.cn: 想象一只麻袋，棕色粗线清晰可见。

abstract.en: Picture a handful of sand that falls in heavy grains.
abstract.cn: 想象一把沉甸甸落下的大颗砂子。

abstract.en: Picture a voice at the next table that is too loud and too rude.
abstract.cn: 想象邻桌那把又响又无礼的嗓子。

examples.en: The path was covered with coarse sand.
examples.cn: 小路上铺着粗砂。

examples.en: A coarse towel felt harsh against his skin.
examples.cn: 粗毛巾擦在皮肤上有些扎。

examples.en: She never used coarse words in front of children.
examples.cn: 她从不在孩子面前说粗话。

dict_mnemonic.text: 把 coarse 记成「没磨过的东西」：布没磨光就扎手，话没磨过就扎耳。

root: 由 course（普通的、平常的）分化出的拼写，十八世纪固定为表示粗糙、粗俗的独立词。

sensesIntro.en: From plain ordinary cloth to rough texture, then to large grains and rude behaviour.
sensesIntro.cn: 从普通的布，到粗糙的质地，再到粗大的颗粒与粗鲁的举止。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a surface that has never been smoothed.
core.cn: 核心意象：从未被打磨光滑的表面。

branches.en: The texture sense is the most physical branch.
branches.cn: 质地义是最具体的一支。

branches.en: Rude words are treated as an unrefined surface.
branches.cn: 粗鲁的话语被当作未经打磨的表面。

branches.en: Large grains show the same refusal to be fine.
branches.cn: 粗大颗粒同样表现出不细。

branches.en: Texture and grain size are two readings of the same surface.
branches.cn: 质地与颗粒大小是同一表面的两种读法。

branches.en: Rough cloth and rough manners share one judgement.
branches.cn: 粗布与粗鲁举止共享同一种评价。

intro.en: The stem takes comparison forms, an adverb, a noun and a verb, plus texture compounds.
intro.cn: 这个词干长出比较级、副词、名词与动词，并构成质地类复合词。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin cursus, a course, through French cours, meaning ordinary.
latinIntro.cn: 词基是拉丁语 cursus（行程），经法语 cours（普通的）而来。

definition_en: the land beside the sea, or to move without much power, especially downhill or through a task

senses.title: Land beside the sea
senses.definition: the land that runs along the edge of the sea

senses.example: We drove along the coast at sunset.
senses.exampleCN: 日落时我们沿着海岸开车。
senses.why: The Latin word meant a rib or a side, and the sea's side of the land took that name.

senses.title: Move without power
senses.definition: to move forward by momentum alone, without using power

senses.example: The bike coasted down the hill.

senses.whyCN: 船在不用帆桨时仍前行叫 coast，车轮也借用了这种运动。

senses.title: Get through with little effort
senses.definition: to succeed or finish with very little effort

senses.example: He coasted through the final test.
senses.exampleCN: 他轻松通过了期末测验。
senses.why: Moving without power became a picture of working without effort.

intro.en: Coast comes from the Latin word for a rib or a side, and then the side of the land.

latinIntro.en: Latin insectum is a cut-in creature, pestis is a plague, and caedere is to cut.

definition_zh: n. 可可粉；热可可饮料；可可色
definition_en: a brown powder made from cacao seeds; a hot drink made from it; a deep brown colour
core_image: 一杯冒着热气的深褐色可可
scene: 冬夜里，她煮了一杯热可可暖手。On a winter night she made a cup of hot cocoa to warm her hands.
sceneCN: 第 2 个义项：cocoa 指热可可饮料；句意是冬夜里，她煮了一杯热可可暖手。

senses.title: A powder from cacao seeds
senses.definition: a brown powder made from roasted cacao seeds
senses.definitionCN: 由烘焙可可豆制成的褐色粉末
senses.example: Add two spoons of cocoa to the flour.
senses.exampleCN: 往面粉里加两勺可可粉。
senses.why: Spanish cacao passed through English spelling.
senses.whyCN: 西班牙语 cacao 经英语拼写演变而来。

senses.title: A hot drink
senses.definition: a hot drink made from cocoa powder and milk or water
senses.definitionCN: 用可可粉加奶或水制成的热饮
senses.example: A cup of cocoa helps him sleep.
senses.exampleCN: 一杯热可可帮他入睡。
senses.why: The powder became the drink made from it.
senses.whyCN: 粉末成了用它冲成的饮料。

senses.title: A deep brown colour
senses.definition: a warm dark brown colour like cocoa
senses.definitionCN: 像可可一样的暖深褐色
senses.example: The wall was painted a soft cocoa.
senses.exampleCN: 墙面刷成了柔和的可可色。
senses.why: The drink s colour gave a colour name.
senses.whyCN: 饮料的颜色成了颜色名。

intro.en: Cocoa travels from a Nahuatl seed name through Spanish into English.
intro.cn: cocoa 从纳瓦特尔语的豆名经西班牙语进入英语。

items.en: The Aztec word names the cacao seed.
items.cn: 阿兹特克语词指可可豆。

items.en: Spanish shortens it to cacao.
items.cn: 西班牙语缩短为 cacao。

items.en: Cacao reaches Europe as a drink.
items.cn: 十六世纪可可作为饮料到达欧洲。

items.en: English spelling settles as cocoa.
items.cn: 十八世纪英语拼写定为 cocoa。

items.en: The word covers powder, drink and colour.
items.cn: 现代该词涵盖粉末、饮料与颜色。

note.en: The look-alike group is a near spelling; the near-meaning group names chocolate and its sources.
note.cn: 形近组是相近拼写；近义组列出巧克力及其来源。

normalIntro.en: Cocoa is cacao after a long journey through Spanish and English spelling.
normalIntro.cn: cocoa 是 cacao 经过西班牙语与英语拼写长途旅行后的样子。

normal.en: Cacao is the tree and seed.
normal.cn: cacao 是树与豆。

normal.en: Cocoa is the powder and drink.
normal.cn: cocoa 是粉与饮料。

normal.en: Cocoa powder is bitter.
normal.cn: 可可粉是苦的。

normal.en: Hot cocoa warms a winter night.
normal.cn: 热可可温暖冬夜。

normal.en: Cocoa is also a deep brown.
normal.cn: cocoa 也是一种深褐色。

abstract.en: A seed that became a colour.
Warmth in a mug.
A rainforest gift to winter.

examples.en: Sift the cocoa with the sugar.
examples.cn: 把可可粉和糖一起过筛。

examples.en: He drinks cocoa before bed every night.
examples.cn: 他每晚睡前都喝可可。

examples.en: The sofa came in a warm cocoa shade.
examples.cn: 这张沙发是温暖的深褐色。

dict_mnemonic.text: 纳瓦特尔语 cacahuatl → 西班牙语 cacao → 英语 cocoa，可可粉与热可可。

root: 纳瓦特尔语 cacahuatl（可可豆）→ 西班牙语 cacao → 英语 cocoa

sensesIntro.en: One seed gives a powder, a winter drink and a brown colour.
sensesIntro.cn: 一颗种子带来一种粉、一杯冬饮与一种褐色。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a steaming brown mug on a dark windowsill
core.cn: 核心意象：暗窗台上冒着热气的一杯褐色饮品

branches.cn: 粉末、饮料与它们共有的颜色。

intro.en: Cocoa is a borrowed plant word; the list adds cacao and flavour pieces.
intro.cn: cocoa 是借来的植物词；下面列出可可与风味词场的词缀。

latinIntro.en: Cacao comes from Nahuatl; scientific names use Theobroma, food of the gods.
latinIntro.cn: cacao 源自纳瓦特尔语；学名使用 Theobroma，意为众神的食物。

latinEntries.exampleCN: cacao 产生 cacao 与 cocoa。
Theobroma 产生 theobroma 与 theobromine。
chocolatl 产生 chocolate 与 chocolaty。
